Subject: HSM firmware & rotation evidence request - ClearStep onboarding

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the walkthrough this morning. As part of ClearStep's SIG+SOC2 intake we need a focused packet on the HSM environment that will protect our tenant keys. Specifically we need the following artifacts and clarifications:

- HSM model and firmware versions in use across production regions, with CVE/patch dates.
- Recent firmware update history (last 12 months) and signed firmware manifest where available.
- Operator shift logs showing which operator identities performed key ceremony operations (sample window: 2028-06-01 -> 2028-07-01).
- Evidence of tamper-evident seals or transport custody for key escrow devices (photos/scans or signed manifests).
- Rotation policy: scheduled rotation windows, automated vs manual steps, and emergency rewrap procedure.

We prefer a single zipped bundle and a short narrative (1 page) describing how firmware updates are validated and how operator access is restricted during ceremonies. Can you confirm an ETA for delivery and whether any items will require an NDA or additional access?

Thanks,
Martin
Security Engineering
ClearStep Financial Services

--

Aditya / Karthik — pulling artifacts now. Quick status: 

1) Firmware inventory: compiled for prod-us-west and prod-us-east. File: hsm-firmware-inventory.csv (columns: host, hsm_model, firmware_version, last_patch_date, cve_notes). I will scrub UUIDs and internal hostnames per policy before export.

2) Signed manifests: we have vendor-signed manifests for the last two firmware updates (2028-03-12 and 2028-06-22). I will include signed-manifest-20280312.pdf and signed-manifest-20280622.pdf. The manifests contain signer certs and SHA256 of firmware blobs; vendor EULA allows providing these to customers for SOC2 review.

3) Operator shift logs (sample): pulled 2028-06-01 -> 2028-07-01. File: operator-shiftlog-sample.txt. I will redact session tokens and IPs, but preserve operator principal names, timestamped actions (key import, key-rotation-init, ceremony-signature).

4) Tamper-evidence custody: we have signed receipt manifests for the last hardware courier exchange. I'll extract the relevant scans (signed-manifest-20280801.pdf) and a photograph stub reference (hsm-seal-photo-20280615.jpg) — note: photos are redacted for customer PII.

5) Narrative: drafting 1-page: firmware validation checks (signature verification, hash compare in isolated air-gapped step), staged rollout with canary HSMs, automated rollback on integrity fail, and emergency rewrap playbook (steps, contact matrix, and DocuSign acknowledgement).

Export plan: single zip: ClearStep_HSM_Evidence_20280802.zip with the files above. I'll upload to the shared Drive folder and share a link-only access to Martin's security account.

Open question: Do we need an NDA? The signed manifests include vendor certs but no customer secrets. My read is no additional NDA required — vendor contract allows sharing with prospective customers for compliance review. If legal disagrees, we'll mark the manifests as view-only via Drive.

I will post the Drive link and HubSpot attachment ID when upload complete. ETA: EOD Wed 2028-08-02.

— Naomi
